about: Every number the checker, handouts and estimate use (blueprint 5.8), with its value, unit, plain meaning and research source. Cards and step files name these constants and never restate the numbers. Written by WP1 on 2026-09-28.
judgement_note: judgement: true marks a value the research gives as a design judgement, to tune in the test runs.

speech_wps_default.meaning: Default speaking pace; a voice's pace_wps overrides it (Saye 2.0).

value.formula: sum over the clip's speeches of (words / pace_wps) <= clip length - margin_s

clip_speech_rule.meaning: Most speech one clip can hold: 17 words in an 8 s clip at 2.5 words per second.

speech_floor_extra_s.meaning: Added to each speech's spoken time in the shot's time floor.

text_floor.meaning: Reading time for text in picture: max(2.0, 1.0 + characters / 13); with emphasis 2 or more at least 2.0 + 0.5 x words; doubled when mirrored ("Goods only. No persons." = 4.0 s, 8.0 s mirrored).

pause_tiers.meaning: Pause tiers as half-open ranges with no gaps: short [0, 1.0), medium [1.0, 2.5), long [2.5, 4.0]; above 4.0 s is a hold, which needs a saved choice (TIME-08).

long_pauses_per_scene_max.meaning: Most long pauses in one scene (TIME-04).

turn_reaction_min_s.meaning: Least reaction time owed after a turn beat (TIME-05, the time floor's pause owed).

handles_s.meaning: Extra frames generated before and after a shot's screen time.

non_dialogue_seconds_by_intensity.meaning: Screen time of a shot without dialogue by beat intensity.

scene_total_tolerance.meaning: A scene's total screen time may differ from target_duration_s by at most this share (TIME-03).

main_actions_per_seconds.meaning: At most one main action per 4 s of moments, unless the shot is marked compound (TIME-06).

acting_characters_per_clip_max.meaning: Most acting characters in one shot or clip (CRAFT-15).

push_in_per_scene_max.meaning: Most push-ins in a scene, on the main turn; a cap, never a quota (CRAFT-01).

extreme_close_up_per_scene_max.meaning: Most extreme close-ups in a scene, on the main turn; a cap, never a quota (CRAFT-02).

extreme_close_up_film_max.meaning: Film-level saved choice: non-insert extreme close-ups in the whole film, written as a RESERVE record at step 6.

push_in_scene_share_max.meaning: Film-level saved choice: push-ins in at most this share of scenes, written as a RESERVE record at step 6.
push_in_scene_share_max.source: card 14's 'push-in on every realisation' trap; B1 R19's budget shape

departments_changing_at_main_turn_max.meaning: Most departments that change at a scene's main turn; scene_idea names them (CRAFT-19).

signals_changing_per_beat_max.meaning: Most of size, light, sound, camera move and colour that change on one beat (CRAFT-19).

display_3_needs_why_at_or_tighter.meaning: display: 3 at this size or tighter needs a why (CRAFT-25).

hold_needs_still_s.meaning: A moment of this length or more, or a pause held on picture, needs a still item on the subject (CRAFT-26).

head_height_m.meaning: Height of a head, used for face height in frame.

face_height_by_size.meaning: Face height by shot size, used when no set plan exists.

motif_spines_max.meaning: Visual spine motifs in a film (FILM-10).

emphasis_3_rules.meaning: Emphasis 3: at most 1 per motif in the film; at most 2 per scene, on different turns, never in consecutive shots (CRAFT-09).

added_emphasis_per_beat_max.meaning: Added emphasis on a beat: at most 1; 0 where the script already marks the beat (CRAFT-10).

plant_emphasis_max.meaning: How loud a plant may be: 1, or 2 for a plot-event plant (CRAFT-08).

device_budget_short.meaning: In a short, at most 2 each of editor-made cut to black, true silence and freeze (CRAFT-12).

batch_size.meaning: Shots written in one reply at step 8: 12 by default, 18 once the self-test passes.

repair_rounds_max.meaning: Most repair rounds per unit; then a CHOICE for the user or a trace to the earliest wrong record.

plate_route_face_height.meaning: A differing face at least this tall sends a mirror shot to the plate route (8.5).

lip_sync_tight_face_height.meaning: A speaking face at least this tall needs tight lip sync.

model_facts_max_age_days.meaning: Model facts older than this block paid packs and money estimates (GEN-11).

takes_stop_per_route.meaning: Stop a route after this many failed takes.

takes_stop_per_shot.meaning: Stop a shot after this many failed takes and change method.

cheap_test_above_usd_per_take.meaning: A take above this price needs a cheaper test first (GEN-16).

value.other_tones: scale [3, 7] by the tone's shot_length_factor in tone_defaults.json

rhythm_class_asl_s.meaning: Average shot length by rhythm class; read only by estimate.py, never a design target.

v0_action_seconds_per_word.meaning: Screen seconds per word of action in the first estimate.

value.basis: visible height at the subject divided by the subject's height; visible height = (36 / lens_mm x distance) / frame ratio

size_ladder_thresholds.meaning: Size check from lens and distance (5.6, GEOM-04).

caption_lead_s.meaning: A shot's first caption starts this long after the shot starts (5.9).

caption_max_s.meaning: Longest caption cue; longer speeches split at a sentence end.

from_blueprint_text.about: Numbers the blueprint states outside the 5.8 table that code or step files use, named here so no file restates them. Source gives the blueprint section.

scene_split_non_blank_lines.meaning: A scene over this many non-blank lines (heading included) is designed in two units by part plus a list unit.

scene_split_beats.meaning: A scene over this many beats is designed in two units by part plus a list unit.

stations_needed_above_beats.meaning: A scene over this many beats names stations (marks) in its staging line.

beat_intensity_5_per_part_max.meaning: Most beats of intensity 5 in one part (CRAFT-05).

lineup_columns_differ_min.meaning: Principals must differ in at least this many of the six lineup columns; sharing four or more is CRAFT-20.

event_unit_scenes.meaning: Scenes per event unit at step 2.

outline_chapters_per_unit.meaning: Chapters per step-outline unit at step 2.

step_outline_tolerance.meaning: Step-outline targets must be within this share of the runtime target (PLAN-04).

alias_mentions_cap.meaning: Source lines listed per element at step 4 (plus every mention with a physical noun).

continuity_unit_scenes.meaning: Scenes per continuity unit at step 5 (prose: one sequence per unit).

checkpoint_b_items_max.meaning: Most numbered items in the big-choices message.

checkpoint_b_marked_items.meaning: Items marked 'these matter most' at checkpoint B.

acceptance_items_max.meaning: Most things for the user to check at acceptance.

scenes_to_read.meaning: Scenes the user reads at acceptance (climax, densest dialogue, biggest action).

question_sample_share.meaning: Seeded share of other shots that get review questions.

film_strip_tokens_per_unit_max.meaning: Above this the film strip is split by act for step 9's judgement units.

selftest_records.meaning: SHOT records the self-test unit writes in one reply.

selftest_scene.meaning: The scene number the self-test uses (one the story does not use).

scene_ids_three_digits_above.meaning: More scenes than this use 3-digit scene IDs.

speech_ids_three_digits_above.meaning: More speeches than this in a scene use 3-digit speech numbers.

shot_number_step.meaning: Shot numbers go in steps of this size; inserts take a number between.

end_card_numbers.meaning: Shot numbers for end cards and black.

issued_blocks.meaning: The ID blocks a step 7 handout pre-issues per scene (beats B01-B30, shots SH010-SH400 in tens).

quote_anchor_words_min.meaning: Each quoted string in a quote anchor has at least this many words (CITE-02).

geometry_angle_change_min_deg.meaning: Consecutive shots of one subject change a size step or at least this angle (GEOM-02).

facing_tolerance_deg.meaning: A previs figure's facing may differ from the derived facing by at most this (PREVIS-03).

previs_plan_level_min.meaning: Shots at this previs level or more get a plan and a blocking check.

previs_width_px.meaning: Previs render width; height = round(width / frame ratio).

previs_sensor_width_mm.meaning: Sensor width of the previs camera.

previs_depth_margin_m.meaning: Added before the nearest and after the farthest subject in depth_range_m.

previs_lying_box.meaning: A lying body's box: height_m by height_m x 0.45 by 0.25 m.

free_fall_half_g.unit: metres per second squared (half of g)
free_fall_half_g.meaning: Free-fall keys use z = z0 - 4.9 t squared.

high_intensity_scene_min.meaning: After a scene of this intensity or more, the next scene's target shot length should be longer (FILM-07).

compliant_sameness_run.meaning: This many consecutive same-setup, same-size, static shots of one subject without a why (FILM-06).

colour_monotony_run.meaning: This many consecutive sequences with the same frame value, saturation and temperature (FILM-04).

undercurrent_scene_share_max.meaning: More than one third of scenes with an undercurrent re-checks the home tone (FILM-12). The value sits just above one third so that exactly a third (10 of 30 scenes) is not 'over a third'.

named_sounds_per_prompt_max.meaning: Most named sounds in one prompt (GEN-17).

spend_check_share.meaning: If half the video money is gone before half the shots are kept, move remaining normal non-dialogue shots to the budget tier.

scales.meaning: Every scale keeps its own name and range and is never converted into another.

short_runtime_max_s.meaning: A film whose first estimate is under this length defaults to format short, otherwise feature; constants with short and feature values read the format.

size_step_difference_warning.meaning: An authored size this many steps or more from the computed size (GEOM-04) or from the dial (CRAFT-17) is a warning.

plant_inserts_per_scene_max.meaning: More plant inserts than this in one scene is heavy-handed (FILM-09).

on_screen_speakers_per_clip_max.meaning: More on-screen speakers than this in one clip is a warning (GEN-13).

voice_description_words.meaning: The length of a voice description, the fixed words for a voice.

style_words_count.meaning: How many plain descriptors STYLE.style_words holds.

look_block_sentences.meaning: The look block's sentences (its words are capped by look_block_words_max).

fact_records_typical.meaning: About how many FACT records a film has at standard depth (suspense, mystery and dramatic irony only); a guide, never a check.

page_eighths_line_model.unit: characters per line, lines per page, eighths
page_eighths_line_model.meaning: The scene's length on the page in eighths (blueprint 5.6 labels and counts, SCENE eighths): each story line wrapped at the action or dialogue width, blank lines kept, rounded up to the next eighth, never under one eighth. An estimate: only a formatted page gives true eighths.
page_eighths_line_model.source: blueprint 5.6; A3 §5.2 (the line-count model: 61 characters per action line, 35 per dialogue line, 55 lines per page; very short scenes are at least 1/8)

previs_stub_level.meaning: The level of a PREVIS stub code creates when a shot names a time_slice or a cut names shared_geometry (PV-SC06-MASTER-V01, level 3).

frame_placement_bands.unit: share of the frame's half width, from the centre (0) to either edge (1)
frame_placement_bands.meaning: Where a projected subject counts as at the centre, a third or an edge of the frame (SHOT subject at, derived with a set plan; GEOM-06), and beyond which it is out of frame.
frame_placement_bands.source: blueprint 5.6 geometry (frame placement projected from the set plan) [judgement, tune in test]

projection_body.meaning: A person's eye point for projection, as a share of their height_m, and the height used when a CHARACTER gives none (5.6 geometry, size check).
